summary.text: Tamiko Mueller is the Democratic candidate for Illinois State Senate District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Paul Jacobs. A U.S. Army Reserve officer and real estate broker, she serves on the Jackson County board.

paragraphs.text: Mueller graduated from O'Fallon Township High School and earned a bachelor's degree in political science and graduate degrees in workforce education and public administration from Southern Illinois University Carbondale.
She has served in the U.S. Army and U.S. Army Reserve, and her career experience includes serving as a military officer and working in real estate.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she enlisted at 17, received her commission through the ROTC program at Southern Illinois University Carbondale, is a Lieutenant Colonel, and deployed twice, including once in response to September 11.
Mueller is a member of the Jackson County Board, representing District 3, according to her survey answers.
She said she is the managing broker and owner of a real estate brokerage and has a nonprofit that helps homeless veterans.
She listed economic development and jobs through infrastructure, affordable health care, and veterans' health care transportation as her key campaign messages.
